@pytest.mark.parametrize('url', ['http://example.invalid/', 'https://example.invalid/'])
def test_request_installs_cipher_context_for_https_and_redirect(mocker, url):
    captured = {}
    real_build_opener = urls.urllib_request.build_opener

    def build_opener(*handlers):
        captured['handlers'] = handlers
        return real_build_opener(*handlers)

    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'build_opener', side_effect=build_opener)
    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen', return_value=mocker.Mock(headers={}))
    cipher = 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256'
    urls.open_url(url, ciphers=[cipher], use_proxy=False)
    handlers = captured['handlers']
    https_handler = next(h for h in handlers if isinstance(h, urls.CustomHTTPSHandler))
    assert any(item['name'] == cipher for item in https_handler._context.get_ciphers())


def test_request_rejects_unsupported_cipher(mocker):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match='Invalid or unsupported TLS ciphers'):
        urls.open_url('https://example.invalid/', ciphers='not-a-real-cipher')

def test_request_cipher_context_with_unix_socket(mocker):
    captured = {}
    real_build_opener = urls.urllib_request.build_opener

    def build_opener(*handlers):
        captured['handlers'] = handlers
        return real_build_opener(*handlers)

    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'build_opener', side_effect=build_opener)
    mocker.patch.object(urls.urllib_request, 'urlopen', return_value=mocker.Mock(headers={}))
    urls.open_url('https://example.invalid/', ciphers='ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256', unix_socket='/tmp/test.sock')
    handler = next(h for h in captured['handlers'] if isinstance(h, urls.HTTPSClientAuthHandler))
    assert any(item['name'] == 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-SHA256' for item in handler._context.get_ciphers())
    assert handler._unix_socket == '/tmp/test.sock'

root_cause_or_environment_statements.text: The regression test fails as expected because the public context builder does not exist. The root cause is the split TLS setup: there is no single point where a user cipher value can be applied to the contexts used by direct HTTPS requests and redirects. I’ll centralize context creation and pass `ciphers=None` explicitly through each public layer.
